**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, EXCLUSIVITY).**

- **Responsive locations inspected:** first § 2.2 (p0013 — the exclusivity grant), duplicate § 2.2 (p0014 — order of precedence, unrelated), § 2.1 (p0012 — no purchase commitment), § 12.3 (p0050 — Vendor acknowledges no exclusivity commitment), plus every other "exclusive" hit (§ 13.1 non-exclusive licence, § 19.4 / § 21.4 / § 30.2 remedies, § 28.2 forum) — none of which imposes sourcing exclusivity on us.
- **Why it fails:** p0013 makes Vendor our sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services for the full term, with no 12-month cap and no automatic termination on service-level or delivery-date failure — walk-away territory, and squarely inconsistent with §§ 2.1 and 12.3.
- **Cure (preferred, validated ok:true):** surgical replacement of "sole and exclusive provider" with "non-exclusive provider", leaving all other wording verbatim and no dangling cross-references (no clause cites § 2.2's exclusivity).
